wave_input: First-order crest-focused JONSWAP/NewWave piston; measured SPH height and breaking are commissioning outputs.

propulsion.basis: Assumed diagnostic force, not a calibrated propulsion operating point

limitations: Coarse pilot; not validated resistance, propulsion efficiency or impact pressure.
Finite tank with downstream damping; later reflections and finite depth remain part of this setup.
Matched force and initial speed do not maintain equal speeds, so differences are not equal-speed added resistance.
Assumed thrust does not add propeller momentum to the water; no actuator disk is present.
16-second transient with a focused wave packet; no extra downward body force is prescribed.
focus_basis: Initial station aligned with the breaking-front region measured in the empty tank; actual ship motion remains free.
interpretation: Linear target crest above still water is not crest-to-trough wave height or significant wave height.
